result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity. The fix is a one-line change in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `listStockByWarehouse` (around line 1493) now filters with `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the category and slow-moving overviews use.

The quantity lookup (`findStockQuantity`) is untouched and already returns 0 when no row exists, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.

`StockOverviewTest`, `StockTest` and `DashboardTest` pass offline. I did not run the full suite, and I did not add a new test for the zero-stock case. The only other caller of the list is the demo scenario, which just prints it.

Nothing is committed.
